description: C-47B-1-DL 43-16284 (c/n 20750, ex YV-AZP, N1848M), FACh 960 from 1953 and the first Chilean aircraft to overfly Antarctica; overturned landing 20 km south of Chaitén on 19 January 1974 and written off. The fuselage was turned into a house (with chimney) by the Anabalón brothers beside the Carretera Austral at El Amarillo, where it remains as the well-known 'casa avión' (modocharlie.com July 2018 with 2017 photos). Not a formal display; visible from the road.
museum_name: Casa Avión C-47 FACh 960, El Amarillo, Chaitén
